liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain, followed by China Cat/Rider, haunted reviewer for years; considered among the best ever Looks Like Rain [17]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower was ablaze, according to the reviewer [21]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire featured extraordinary Brent and Jerry interplay in the segue; one of the reviewer's favorites [14]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Good Lovin' was extremely loud, likened by the reviewer's brother to a jet plane in a bathtub [16]

## The recordings

- **gd81-12-09.sbd.clugston.13061.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 183 min; rated 4.2/5 by 30 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says recording is great; minimal static early on that seems to disappear by Bird Song; The VBR version of Scarlet has a splice that other tapes of this show lack [12][14]
- **gd1981-12-09.sbd.motu.11626.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Reel splice occurs during Fire; tape fades in after Bird Song [2]
- **gd1981-12-09.sbd.miller.87349.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 184 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd1981-12-09.158935.mtx.seamons.ht152.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 183 min [4]. Said about its sound: Light PA static throughout, masked by the matrix; soundboard shows above-average clipping, particularly during Cold Rain and Snow; A tiny repeated hiccup in the soundboard between Fire on the Mountain and Estimated Prophet was removed [4]

## Around the show

- Freezing night outside, hot inside the Events Center; the show was a surprise of winter 1981 [14]
- Reviewer found front sound muddy and watched from behind the stage, among racks of speakers in a small space [18]
- Show was loud and powerful; a CU student brought friends, who got separated in the chaos and regrouped in a nearby field [21]
- Reviewer, whose first show this was, felt the band played the Stones songs better than the Stones themselves [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-12-09.sbd.clugston.13061.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard and Audience composite [1]. Also: Master soundboard cassette to reel to reel to DAT to CDR; Sennheiser 421 audience source fills gaps; Audience source supplies Mama Tried, start of Mexicali Blues, and Space through into The Other One [1]
- **gd1981-12-09.sbd.motu.11626.shnf**: transferred by MOTU; source: SBD>Rm>Dat>CD [2]. Also: Zephyr made patches from an unknown audience source covering Mama Tried, part of Mexicali, end of Space, start of The Other One [2]
- **gd1981-12-09.sbd.miller.87349.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch Reel @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Jim Wise's Sennheiser 421 master cassette audience source supplies end of Bird Song, end of Space and start of The Other One [3]
- **gd1981-12-09.158935.mtx.seamons.ht152.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) December 9, 2022 [4]. Also: Matrix of soundboard and audience; audience tape flips in He's Gone and The Other One patched with Rip Tompkins' recording [4]
